title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) trending toward playing in Week 6
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) is trending toward playing on Sunday against the Jets.
items.impact: Brown has gotten in limited practice sessions each of the last two days. He has not played since being knocked out of the season opener due to a high-ankle sprain.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Darius Slayton released by Colts
items.desc: Darius Slayton was released by the Colts on Friday.
items.impact: After being released by the Giants just before the season began, Slayton signed with the Colts in late September. The veteran receiver never got into a game for the Colts and has now been cut loose again. Slayton will now try to find another new team.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Eric Murray (concussion) trending toward playing Sunday
items.desc: Eric Murray (concussion) is trending toward being active for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Head coach Liam Coen said Friday morning that he feels "more confident" about Murray being able to play in Week 6. Murray missed Week 5's win against the Eagles. If he cannot go Sunday, Rayuan Lane would be in line to start again.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Henry To'oTo'o (shoulder) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Texans opened the practice window of Henry To'oTo'o.
items.impact: To'oTo'o will have 21 days to officially be activated by Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Gesky signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed OL Josh Gesky to the practice squad.
items.impact: Gesky will add depth on the offensive line for the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shawn Bowman promoted to 53-man roster
items.desc: The Cardinals promoted TE Shawn Bowman to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Bowman will add depth in the tight end room for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kitan Crawford (ankle) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Cardinals opened the practice window of Kitan Crawford.
items.impact: Crawford will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Irvin Charles moved to Seahawks practice squad
items.desc: The Seahawks moved WR Irvin Charles to their practice squad.
items.impact: Charles was activated from injured reserve this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Velus Jones Jr. signs with Seahawks 53-man roster
items.desc: The Seahawks signed RB Velus Jones Jr. to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Jones will add depth in the backfield for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alaric Jackson has suspension reduced to one game
items.desc: The NFL has reduced Rams LT Alaric Jackson's two-game suspension to one game.
items.impact: Jackson will only miss Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) will not return before bye week
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Demarcus Robinson will not return before the bye in Week 8.
items.impact: Robinson remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to avoid IR
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Deebo Samuel would be an IR consideration but they're going to hold off because of the bye in Week 8.
items.impact: Samuel will likely remain sidelined through the bye week for San Francisco. He is week-to-week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Thompson was again limited on Thursday as he continues to manage a quad injury. If he plays in Week 6, he may see more opportunities than usual with Ladd McConkey (foot) and Quentin Johnston (chest) uncertain to play against the Chiefs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday due to a rib injury. He should play in Week 6 and will see more work than usual with the high number of injuries that Los Angeles is dealing with to their wideouts right now.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) limited Thursday
items.desc: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Lambert-Smith continues to work his way back from a hamstring injury and was limited at practice again on Thursday. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end practiced in a full capacity for a second-straight day on Thursday, indicating that he's nearly fully healthy at this point. He should play in Week 6 but doesn't project to be fantasy relevant moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) was absent from another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: James wasn't able to practice on Thursday, making it unlikely that he will suit up and play in Week 6. Los Angeles' secondary will be significantly weaker if he's ruled out for this matchup against the Chiefs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Quentin Johnston (chest) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnston's chest injury continues to linger and left him limited for another practice session on Thursday. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect much production out of him this week, even if he's cleared to play heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Tre' Harris (hamstring) missed Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Harris wasn't able to practice on Thursday due to a hamstring injury, which left him sidelined on Wednesday as well. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined in Week 6, which is bad news for the Chargers with Ladd McConkey (foot) also uncertain to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: McConkey was limited for another practice on Thursday, which comes as no surprise, considering that he is uncertain to play in Week 6 due to his foot issue. Friday's injury report should tell us much more about his official injury status heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kayode Awosika (leg) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika (leg) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Awosika remained sidelined for another practice on Thursday due to the same fibula injury that has been bothering him recently. He isn't likely to play in Week 6, and Los Angeles' offensive line is set to be weaker than usual ahead of a matchup against the Chiefs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Alt (neck) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Joe Alt (neck) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Alt was unable to practice on Thursday. He will almost certainly be sidelined in Week 6, which will make life much tougher for Los Angeles' offense ahead of a matchup against the Chiefs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dee Alford (ankle) considered limited Thursday
items.desc: Dee Alford (ankle) was considered a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Alford was considered a limited participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday as well. He seems to be trending the right way for Week 6, which is good news for Buffalo's defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joshua Palmer (shoulder) still limited Thursday
items.desc: Joshua Palmer (shoulder) was still limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Palmer was limited for another practice on Thursday due to the shoulder injury that continues to bother him. He may play through it in Week 6 and will be in line for more work than usual if DJ Moore (shoulder) is unable to play against the Raiders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) doesn't practice again Thursday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (knee) did not take part in practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran lineman wasn't able to practice again on Thursday, as he's still dealing with some kind of a knee issue. It could leave him sidelined on Sunday, but we won't know more until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Moore was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday. The team continues to hold him out due to a nagging shoulder issue, and it remains to be seen if it will affect his availability for Week 6. If it does, fantasy managers should expect more work for Keon Coleman against the Raiders as a result.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Ty Johnson (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnson was able to practice on Thursday, though he was limited by a hamstring injury again. It seems likely that he will be active and continue to play a depth role for the Bills again in Week 6.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (knee) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Trent Brown (knee) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran lineman was able to make his return to practice on Thursday and put up a full practice session. His knee injury is a non-issue at this point and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 6.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was officially a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Al-Shaair made his return to practice on Thursday and seems to be trending the right way for Week 6. He is traveling with the team to London, so it looks likely that he will be cleared to play ahead of game time on Sunday morning.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) doesn't practice again Thursday
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) did not take part in Arizona's practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie is still managing an ankle issue and was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday as a result. It could leave him sidelined in Week 6, which would lead to a lot more work for Tyler Allgeier in a divisional matchup against the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Davis Allen (foot) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Davis Allen (foot) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Allen was not able to practice for a second-straight day on Thursday. His foot injury is still bothering him and may very well leave him sidelined in Week 6, though that wouldn't have a big fantasy impact ahead of a matchup against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: A shoulder injury is still bothering Parkinson and left him limited at Thursday's practice. It would be less than ideal for the Rams if the veteran was sidelined this week because of it, especially with Terrance Ferguson (ankle) already out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) full participant Thursday
items.desc: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thornton was a full participant at another practice on Thursday. He seems to be fully healthy at this point, so the Raiders should activate him to their active roster any day now.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Nailor (concussion) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Nailor (concussion) returned to practice for the Raiders on Thursday.
items.impact: Nailor was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday, and his return is a good sign that he is trending in the right direction. If he's out for another game on Sunday, fantasy managers should expect more work for Tre Tucker against the Bills.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Bowers was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by his knee injury on Wednesday. He should be fully good to go for Week 6 and remains a must-start fantasy option moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Rachaad White (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to log a full practice session to start the week on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 6 and will be primed for more work than usual if Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is unable to play on Monday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Treylon Burks (shoulder) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Treylon Burks (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A shoulder injury left Burks limited at practice on Thursday. It doesn't look like it will leave him sidelined for Week 6, however, and he will again be primed for more work than usual if Stefon Diggs (hamstring) misses another game for Washington.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McLaurin was able to practice on Thursday, though he remained limited due to the nagging hamstring issue that he's still managing. He should still play in Week 6 and could be startable in many leagues, especially if Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is ruled out for the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Austin Ekeler (chest) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Austin Ekeler (chest) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back was able to practice on Thursday, but he was limited due to a chest injury that he's managing. He should be available to play on Monday night still and will see more work than usual if Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is sidelined against San Francisco.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) officially DNP Thursday
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) officially didn't practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt wasn't seen during the open portion of practice on Friday, and he was indeed sidelined due to a groin issue. It may leave him sidelined in Week 6, although he still has a couple of days to return to practice before the team begins to rule people out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thursday was San Francisco's first practice of the week, so to no surprise, they gave McCaffrey the day off as a veteran rest day. He should be back on Friday and is expected to be a full go for Monday night's game against the Washington Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Juszczyk was able to practice on Thursday and seems to be on track to make his return to the lineup in Week 6. He won't have any fantasy value himself when he's back, but his presence should improve San Francisco's offense as a whole moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Christian Kirk (calf) was officially a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Kirk was officially limited in his first practice back on Thursday. He's currently in his 21-day practice window, so the team could choose to let him sit out for another game or two before he's back in the lineup officially.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) officially did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't able to practice on Thursday. He's still dealing with a nagging issue with his ribs, but now he's also dealing with an Achilles injury of some kind. Fantasy managers should monitor his status throughout the week to make sure he will suit up and play on Monday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bosa has been sidelined for three-straight games due to a couple of injuries that he's dealing with, and he wasn't able to practice on Thursday either. He reportedly has a chance to make his return this week, however, so it remains to be seen if he will make his return to practice on Friday or Saturday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marcus Epps (groin) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Marcus Epps (groin) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Epps was able to practice in full on Thursday after being limited by a groin issue on Wednesday. He should play in Week 6, which will make life more difficult for Bryce Young and the Panthers' offense on the other side of the ball.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Steen (shoulder) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Steen (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Steen wasn't able to practice in full on Thursday, as he's still recovering from a minor shoulder injury of some kind. Philadelphia's offensive front is already looking weaker than usual for Week 6, but it will be especially bad if Steen is also unable to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) did not take part in Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wicks was not able to practice on Thursday. He's managing some kind of a hamstring issue and seems to be trending the wrong way for Week 6. Look for rookie Makai Lemon to see more work if Wicks is out this week, although neither of them should be started in this matchup against the Panthers either way.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eli Stowers (quad) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Eli Stowers (quad) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has yet to take the field for the Eagles this season due to a quad injury that left him on injured reserve. He has practiced in a limited capacity all week so far, however, which leaves him with a chance to play in Week 6. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him even if he's active, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring/toe) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring/toe) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: At first it looked like Smith was absent from Thursday's practice, but he turned out to be a limited participant. He's dealing with two separate injuries still, so it's very possible that he will be sidelined in Week 6, which would leave Dallas Goedert with more work than usual against the Panthers.
